g.text: Cue — AI Pipeline (proposal view, not an implemented system)
Inference path (product) and training/evaluation path (research, independent of the product database)
OFFLINE — dataset, training, evaluation (research, independent of the product)
Cue generator (registered model_version, loaded by the GPU worker)
Media store: frames archive (ZIP of PNG) + MP4
job done, model_version and seed recorded
Thick purple border = proposed component, not yet implemented or verified (training path conditioning on first+last frame,
memory fit on the chosen GPU and plan-module effect are explicit week-1/week-5 checks in the proposal).
Grey = existing pretrained component. Green = application step. Amber = data / storage.
Without an instruction, steps 2-4 are skipped and the model runs on the two drawings alone.
Training uses plans derived from scenario labels; inference uses plans from the LLM or the user (same schema).
